name: Necrochasm

frame.name: Cursebringer
frame.description: Precision final blows with this weapon increase reload speed and trigger a Cursed Thrall explosion that inflicts corruption. Final blows with Cursed Thrall explosions refill the magazine.

perks.name: Arrowhead Brake
perks.description:
Lightly vented barrel.
  •  Greatly controls recoil
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Ricochet Rounds
perks.description:
Rounds ricochet off hard surfaces. 
  •  Increases stability 
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Desperation
perks.description: Reloading after a precision final blow or a final blow with a Cursed Thrall explosion increases your rate of fire and improves stability and aim assist.

perks.name: Hand-Laid Stock
perks.description:
This weapon is optimized for recoil control.
  •  Increases stability

flavor: Is your Light bright enough to stand in full gaze of the Hive's abyss?

catalyst.name: Necrochasm Catalyst
catalyst.description: Hitting three separate targets increases damage, range, handling, and aim assist for a moderate duration.
